# About me

Juniper is an invented person, used only in tests.

## What I do

I keep a market garden and teach a weekend course on soil. Most of my week is outdoors and I read on Sunday evenings with a pot of tea.

## What I want to understand better

Regenerative horticulture, seed saving, and how small growers organise themselves. I like practical reports from people who actually grow things.

## What I never want to see

Gadget reviews, lawn care, and anything about cryptocurrency.

## How long I want to read each week

About half an hour.
